description: 1 staging, 2 main, 3 upper. A switch number is on one level only; the numbers are unique railroad-wide.

The switch number (the plate number). A switch's rows go together, its first row first: a crossover has one row per OS block (staging: os:7:A-13C and os:7:A-5B) or per half (main and upper: 101A and 101B).

Main and upper: the label the drawings print for this row, the switch number (107) or the number and A or B for a crossover half (101A). It is the row's key. Staging leaves it blank: its rows are keyed by os_id.

Staging: the device ID of the OS block through this row's points (os:<n>, or a crossover half's os:<n>:A-<end>; hartlib.device_ids), the row's key to the device master. A crossover has one row per OS block; the first row's is the switch's primary OS block (the Layout Editor blockname and first CTC OS sensor). The block's name is the name store's (devices_field.csv): hartlib.railroad_facts.read_switch_rows gives it as SwitchRow.os_block, so a rename needs no edit here. Main and upper leave it blank.
Staging: the device ID of the block the leg leads to when the switch is closed (CATS normal unless cats_inverted): block:<ends> or os:<n>. read_switch_rows gives its name as SwitchRow.closed_leg.
Staging: the device ID of the block the leg leads to when the switch is thrown. read_switch_rows gives its name as SwitchRow.thrown_leg.

L or R: the diverging side seen from the points, or blank where nobody has recorded it. Main and upper give it per half; staging on the switch's first row only (a crossover's later rows leave hand and hand_source blank).

Where the hand comes from: plan (main and upper only; tools/schematic/build_hands.py writes it from the AnyRail plan graph and rewrites only these rows) or owner (hand-kept; build_hands.py never touches it, and it needs a hand). A new plan row may leave hand blank: build_hands.py fills it. Blank when nobody has recorded a hand.

Main and upper: the LCOS node area of a local switch, one in no control point (a yard or industry spur), one of lcos_nodes.csv's areas. Blank for a control point switch, whose area is its interlocking's (interlockings.csv). On the switch's first row only.
Staging: the live Layout Editor turnout ident (TOL3). On the switch's first row only; blank on main and upper.
Staging: yes when CATS normal is JMRI thrown, else no. On the switch's first row only; blank on main and upper.
Staging: the USS CTC lever's first internal sensor number (IS<n>), given to one switch only. On the switch's first row only; blank on main and upper.
Staging: yes when the USS CTC lever column has signal levers, no for a switch-only column. On the switch's first row only; blank on main and upper.
Free text for people. On the switch's first row only.
